name: plan-manager.plan-inventory
purpose: List non-archived plans through Plan Manager and return bounded identity/status metadata.
assumptions: Plan Manager is reachable; ListPlans returns all matching plans without server pagination.
invariants: Read only; archived plans stay excluded.
Do not return plan titles, descriptions, phases, or authored content.
The typed owner list returns bounded pages and total/has_more metadata.

signals.description: Plan id, slug, status, last update, page count, total, has_more, offset and limit.
